GAAP net income for the fiscal third quarter ended June 30, 2026, was $5.6 billion, or $2.97 per share, representing a 7% and 10% increase over the prior year period, respectively.
Non-GAAP net income for the quarter was $6.3 billion, or $3.32 per share, reflecting an 8% and 11% increase over the prior year’s results on a reported and constant-dollar basis, respectively.
Data processing revenue rose 17% to $6.0 billion

Payments volume for the three months ended June 30, 2026, increased 10% on a constant-dollar basis over the prior year ... Cross-border volume excluding intra-Europe transactions increased 12% on a constant-dollar basis

claims.claim: GAAP net income for the fiscal third quarter ended June 30, 2026 was $5.6 billion.
GAAP earnings per share for the fiscal third quarter were $2.97.
GAAP net income increased 7% over the prior-year period.
GAAP earnings per share increased 10% over the prior-year period.
Non-GAAP net income for the quarter was $6.3 billion.
Non-GAAP earnings per share for the quarter were $3.32.
The non-GAAP increases of 8% and 11% over the prior year were on a reported and constant-dollar basis, respectively.
claims.note: Basis mis-assigned. The release pairs the 8% with non-GAAP net income and the 11% with non-GAAP EPS, both as reported; the constant-dollar non-GAAP EPS growth (~11%) is disclosed separately, and no constant-dollar non-GAAP net income growth is given.

claims.claim: Net revenue was $11.6 billion, an increase of 14% year-over-year.
Net revenue increased 13% on a constant-dollar basis.
Net revenue growth was driven by growth in payments volume, cross-border volume, and processed transactions.
GAAP operating expenses were $4.8 billion, a 19% increase over the prior year.
The increase in GAAP operating expenses was primarily due to higher personnel expenses.
Non-GAAP operating expenses increased 17% year-over-year.
Payments volume for the three months ended June 30, 2026 increased 10% on a constant-dollar basis over the prior year.
Total processed transactions reached 71.7 billion, up 10%.
Cross-border volume excluding intra-Europe transactions increased 12% on a constant-dollar basis.
Total cross-border volume increased 13% on a constant-dollar basis for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Data processing revenue rose 17% to $6.0 billion.
International transaction revenue grew 6% to $3.9 billion.
Other revenue rose 45% to $1.5 billion.
The release does not provide specific financial guidance or a quantitative outlook for future periods.
Management commentary indicates consumer and business spending remains resilient.
Management indicates the company is positioning itself to capture growth opportunities across consumer payments, commercial solutions, and value-added services.
Cash, cash equivalents, and investment securities were $13.9 billion as of June 30, 2026.
The company repurchased approximately 14.5 million shares of class A common stock for $4.9 billion during the quarter.
$28.4 billion of authorized funds for share repurchases remained.
Total cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash, and restricted cash equivalents decreased to $18.8 billion from $25.0 billion at the beginning of the nine-month period.
Financing activities in the nine-month period included $16.4 billion in stock repurchases and $3.9 billion in dividends paid.
The decrease in total cash was largely due to financing activities.
GAAP operating expense growth of 19% significantly outpaced revenue growth.
Personnel and marketing costs are rising.
The company deposited $250 million into its litigation escrow account in June 2026.
